decision.observation: Hornet stands at the golden wire sphere. Its acorn-knob arm sits upper-right; a small golden item rests at the base-left on the stone path. The bell-like form with a clapper resembles a station/bench-type interactable. Attack, harpoon, tool, and jumps have all been inert.
decision.hypothesis: In this genre, benches/stations activate by a sustained 'Bind' (rest) rather than striking. Holding Bind (A) adjacent to the bell might activate it.
decision.memory: Golden bell station untested with sustained Bind (A) hold at point-blank.
